setSaveOnBattle: Press BATTLE to save the current equipment
setSaveOnBattleTooltip:
{HEADER}Press BATTLE to save{/HEADER}{BODY}Pressing BATTLE writes the equipment currently mounted on the tank into its saved set, so a loadout you just rebuilt is the one that comes back - no need to remember the Save button.
Switching to another tank saves the one you are leaving in the same way.

Only tanks that already have a saved set are updated: saving a set is how you hand a tank to this mod, and that stays your decision.
A tank whose equipment does not match its saved set to begin with is left alone as well - because auto-install is off, or because the mod could not get hold of everything yet. Saving there would drop the equipment you are still waiting for out of the set.{/BODY}
importDropdownLabel: Import saved configs from kurzdor's auto equipment return
importOwnDropdownLabel: Import saved configs from another of your accounts
importOtherAccountTooltip:
{HEADER}Import only from your own account{/HEADER}{BODY}kurzdor stores his vehicles by inventory id. Those ids only mean something inside one account.
On a different account the same ids belong to different vehicles, so an import would put the equipment on the wrong tanks.

How to get the saved equipments anyway:
1. Run this mod on the original account and import the saved equipment there.
2. Then, from this account, import that account's file – via "Import saved configs from another of your accounts".{/BODY}
